title: Star's DiscordCommand
description: Adds a simple /discord command that adds you to the Discord server from your Minecraft server
body:
# Discord Command
**by StarSMP Developement**

This plugin adds a simple /discord command that adds you to the Discord server from your Minecraft server

## Supported Version
**1.21.1 - 1.21.11**

The Discord Link is configurable in config.yml

```
discord-link: "https://discord.gg/qZ7SqmsCRr"

messages:
  no-permission: "&cYou do not have permission to use this command."
```


**This plugin is made by the Developement from the server xStarSMP.de**
**Join our Discord**: https://www.discord.gg/EcWcWMb9wr
